title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: export day-level Copilot metrics
summary: The briefing passes: the current Microsoft pages support its export behaviour, default, licensing prerequisites and controls, and its rollout dates match the supplied records. Minor corrections should include the policy target selections in the paths and remove checklist steps whose controls are missing from the table.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <FeatureId from Get-VivaModuleFeature> -Name <policy name> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disable policy for the selected feature.
